payload.system: Split a transmission project title into its named endpoints (substations or places). Return at most two names, without voltages, numbers or words like Rebuild/Line/Substation.
payload.prompt:
Title: GTC: Camden Industrial Park 230/115kV New Substation
Description: GTC will construct a new 230/115kV substation with a three element 230kV ring bus, two element 115kV ring bus, and one new 230/115kV 400MVA transformer. A new 115kV line to Kinlaw substation will be built also.
